fns.desc: get_val() leaks 'val' (heap string from xml_node_get_text/xmlNodeGetContent) when the text is entirely whitespace: the scan loop falls through to 'return NULL;' without ever calling xml_node_get_text_free(ctx, val), unlike the early 'return val;' path. Triggered by any XML text node containing only whitespace (e.g. pretty-printed/indented MO or PPS XML).
